description: Run the local pre-commit gate for the memex repo before staging a commit: format check, clippy with warnings denied, and the workspace unit-test suite, mirroring memex's own CI. Use right before `commit-changes` on a memex working tree, after editing any Rust crate under `crates/`, or when reproducing a red CI run locally. Optionally runs the Postgres-gated integration suite when the `memex-pg` container is up and `.env` is sourced. This is a verification gate, NOT a replacement for memex CI — CI remains the authority; this catches failures earlier.
